name: manual_0d8d34
claim: OR IGNORE only suppresses uniqueness/PK conflicts, never foreign-key violations -- an INSERT with FK ON referencing an unknown parent row still raises sqlite3.IntegrityError even with OR IGNORE

decisions.notes: CodeRabbit review #4989313231 on PT PR #359: mark_dispatch()'s INSERT OR IGNORE INTO tier5_budget_stages references tier5_budget_runs(run_id) with PRAGMA foreign_keys=ON. A caller passing an unknown run_id (no reservation row) hit a raw sqlite3.IntegrityError instead of the ledger's own BudgetError -- OR IGNORE reads as blanket error suppression but only covers the INSERT's own uniqueness constraints, not FK checks against other tables. Caught by TDD retroactive-RED: wrote test_mark_dispatch_on_unknown_run_id_raises_budget_error_not_integrity_error, confirmed it failed with sqlite3.IntegrityError pre-fix, then wrapped the INSERT in try/except sqlite3.IntegrityError translating to BudgetError.
